text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace won the three-way battle at 
the Japan Cup, staking her claim as one of 
the Big Three.

Despite their defeat, Mr. C.B. and Symboli 
Rudolf were already fired up for a 
rematch. The three of them promised to 
clash again at the Arima Kinen.

As Japan's "Ace," Katsuragi Ace intends to 
defeat any opponent who stands in her way. 
She declares that the Arima Kinen will be 
hers!
